strongest_angle: Priscilla Presley secured a partial legal victory in Los Angeles County Superior Court on November 16, 2026, when Judge Mark Epstein dismissed four out of twenty-one claims in a $50 million lawsuit filed by her former business advisers.

key_facts.fact: On November 16, 2026, Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge Mark Epstein issued a ruling dismissing four out of 21 claims in a $50 million lawsuit against Priscilla Presley.
Priscilla Presley successfully persuaded the court to dismiss four claims involving a cosmetics agreement and the use of her own name, image, and likeness.
Los Angeles County Superior Court Judge Mark Epstein refused Priscilla Presley's request to strike disputed passages regarding Elvis Presley and Lisa Marie Presley from the legal filings.
